correctness.rationale: For connected simple outerplanar graphs under uniform-start 1-WL, the complete unlabeled population counts at n=1..8 are 1,1,2,5,13,46,172,777. Every connected outerplanar n=8 graph has a removable non-cut vertex of degree 1 or 2 (terminal outerplanar block ear), and alternatively any n=8 connected graph is an arbitrary-neighborhood one-vertex extension of some connected 7-vertex parent; exhaustive atlas cases justify global coverage. Independently implemented fresh generator from 172 outerplanar n=7 atlas parents enumerated and deduplicated all 777 n=8 classes, 75 biconnected, exactly four failures of stable WL versus full automorphism orbit, exactly two biconnected. Fresh independent automorphism/refinement checks on all four explicitly listed labeled 8-vertex witnesses verified their exact partitions, edge counts and automorphism orders 8,8,4,2. Thus the sharp cutoff at n=8 is mathematically exhaustive, not extrapolated from samples.
residual_risks: Both independent enumerators (original and fresh) use NetworkX graph atlas/isomorphism/planarity, a shared software dependency.
No claim for n>=9 or cross-graph color-refinement identification.
